title: Epic summary: the pager when the last PR opens, /summary, and the offer to close the Epic
description:
Per the map ticket 'Prototype: the modal for Plan review and the Epic summary' (harness-0sx.5), layout B Pager, and the map's Notes (Epic summary); prototype as in Ticket 5.

Once per Epic run, when no Ticket is left in the Pipeline and every Ticket has its PR open or merged or is parked, the summary opens by itself over the whole terminal: a title bar 'EPIC DONE · <epic> <title>' with 'N PRs · N parked' and the badges; a lead ('Every Ticket has its PR. Review and merge them; each Ticket closes as its PR merges.') and the totals ('N Rounds · N Findings fixed · N skipped · N left on its PR · N parked'); a Tickets outline on the left from 100 columns (it drops below that); one section per Ticket: a rule in the Ticket's color ending in merged or to merge, 'PR #N <url>', 'N Rounds · N fixed · N skipped · N left', then each skipped Finding and each Finding left on the PR; a PARKED section with the reasons; a position line 'rows a–b of n · p%'. Left on the PR: the fix items of the last Round's Verdict when it was the cap, which no Review re-checked. Read only: ↑↓ a line, PgUp/PgDn/Space a page, Tab Ticket to Ticket, Esc closes. No cursor: PRs open by Cmd-clicking their URLs.

Built fresh each time from bd (the Epic's Tickets, closed = merged), the State and each Ticket's Run directory evidence: verdict-N.md for Rounds and the fix and skip items, the Fix result's PR: line. Pipeline::prune_run_dir keeps the .md evidence, so the Verdicts outlive the run.

/summary, a new command in Ticket 4's command table: alone it shows the saved or most recent run's Epic; '/summary @<epic>' (the @ list offers Epics) shows that Epic's. An Epic with no evidence is a notice.

Closing: Tickets still close on merge by poll_merges. When the last one merges (the scheduler's 'Epic done, every Ticket closed'), a yes/no confirmation offers 'close Epic <id> <title>?'; yes runs bd close <epic> --reason 'every Ticket merged', no leaves it open.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Over a fake Run directory (verdict-1.md to verdict-3.md, fix-N.md with a PR: line) and a fake bd: the totals and each Ticket's counts; a parked Ticket under PARKED with its reason. The summary opens by itself once when the last PR opens, not before. /summary after a merge shows that Ticket merged; /summary @<epic> shows another Epic. TestBackend renders at 120x40 and at 90x30 (outline dropped); Esc closes. The close confirmation on the last merge runs bd close on yes and nothing on no.
